WITH store_counts AS (
  SELECT store_id, COUNT(customer_id) AS customer_count
  FROM customer
  GROUP BY store_id
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS total_count
  FROM store_counts
),
matched AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, s.customer_count, s.customer_count * 1.0 / t.total_count AS count_share
  FROM store_counts AS s
  JOIN total AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL
),
average AS (
  SELECT AVG(customer_count) AS average_count
  FROM matched
)
SELECT m.store_id, m.customer_count, m.count_share, m.customer_count - a.average_count
FROM matched AS m
JOIN average AS a ON a.average_count IS NOT NULL
